operation.description: Returns a boolean indicating whether or not private vulnerability reporting is enabled for the repository. For more information, see "[Evaluating the security settings of a repository](https://docs.github.com/code-security/security-advisories/working-with-repository-security-advisories/evaluating-the-security-settings-of-a-repository)".

enabled.description: Whether or not private vulnerability reporting is enabled for the repository.

operation.summary: Check if private vulnerability reporting is enabled for a repository

#/components/parameters/owner.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/owner.name: owner

#/components/parameters/repo.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/repo.name: repo
